headword: {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}
gloss: fully prepared; all set; everything in readiness

definitions.gloss: fully prepared; all set; everything in readiness
definitions.explanation: A state where all preparations are complete and nothing is left to do. Expresses thorough readiness.

examples.japanese: {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}だ。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}→旅行：00748_ryokou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧。
examples.english: All the travel preparations are in order.

examples.japanese: {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}んだ→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{散々|さんざん}→散々：10323_sanzan⟧だった。
examples.english: Despite being fully prepared for the match, the result was terrible.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ (preparation) + ⟦{万端|ばんたん}→万端：16969_bantan⟧ (everything, all matters). ⟦{万端|ばんたん}→万端：16969_bantan⟧ literally means 'ten thousand ends' — every loose end is tied up. Often used as a predicate with だ or as an adverbial modifier.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}だ: to be all set
- {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}う→整う：03935_totonou⟧: all preparations come together
- {準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{臨|のぞ}む→臨む：29038_nozomu⟧: to face something fully prepared

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{万全|ばんぜん}→万全：05932_banzen⟧: perfect, flawless (describes the state of readiness itself, not specifically preparations)
- ⟦{用意周到|よういしゅうとう}→用意周到：19898_youishuutou⟧: thoroughly prepared (emphasizes careful planning rather than completion of tasks)

USAGE:
Can function as a noun ({準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{整|ととの}った→整う：03935_totonou⟧) or as a な-adjective-like predicate ({準備万端|じゅんびばんたん}だ). Often used with an optimistic or confident tone.
